'''205.104/G3''' was a [[Stormtrooper Commander/Legends|stormtrooper commander]] assigned to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Garrison/Legends|garrison]] on [[Mentanar Vosk]]. The commander was assigned to lead two stormtrooper squads to attack elements of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance's]] [[Strike Force Altagak]].
